policy_notes: All rates are per filled leg, not automatically round-trip and not a percentage of account NAV.
Rates are decimal strings; use Decimal, not percent-as-fraction confusion.
Recording categories does not enable instruments or authorize trading them.
Map the exact exchange/product/symbol/fee zone before selecting a rate. Do not silently use the cheapest or standard rate for unknown zones.
Options rows record displayed percentages only; validate the product-specific fee base, caps and settlement/exercise charges separately.
TradFi row is a screenshot promotion snapshot. Its duration is unknown; do not extrapolate it to old periods or crypto contracts.
No MNT discount is assumed, and no purchase, setting change or account/API-key access is authorized.
Spread, slippage, funding and borrowing are independent economic components; none is included in these displayed commission rates.
A limit order is not automatically maker. Preserve taker fees for immediate/liquidity-taking executions.
A 20 bp spot round-trip assumption is not the same as a 20 bp standard derivatives per-leg fee.
